diagnostics.message: Power is conditional on the declared two-construct reflective Gaussian data-generating design and target path.
Failed or inadmissible replicates remain in the denominator as non-rejections.
The selected value is the first evaluated grid point whose Wilson lower confidence bound reaches target power; no interpolation or extrapolation is performed.
Planned desktop workload: 200 simulated datasets, 20000 PLS fits, and 1800000 row-fits; actual duration depends on the model, grid, and hardware.

Each stream_identity identifies the deterministic indexed random-number stream for one (sample size, replicate) pair; the scientific recipe digest, not stream_identity, binds the declared path, loadings, and full data-generating design.
Formative, higher-order, interaction, nonlinear, mixture, multigroup, endogeneity, weighted, clustered, ordinal, matrix-only, and missing-data designs are outside v1.
Retrospective observed power and heuristic sample-size rules are not part of this calculation.

exclusions: Formative, higher-order, interaction, nonlinear, mixture, multigroup, endogeneity, weighted, clustered, ordinal, matrix-only, and missing-data designs are outside v1.
